text:
Prepared bounded spatial-direction experiment, with prospective design at benchmarks/halfflow/experiments/spatial-direction-v1.json and equations/rationale at docs/benchmarks/halfflow-optimizer-experiment-v1.md. One opt-in direction policy; two otherwise identical step-scaled lanes; six observed pairs (OASIS11,13,MMRR11 sentinels + OASIS1,15,17 prior successes). OASIS15 is selected before candidate outcomes from its existing strict bidirectional affine-improvement receipt to meet P01's three-success screen. Reserve12 full fits (6replays+6candidate), all charged to development budget; zero candidate fits executed. Baseline replays must match completed deferred maps where available; OASIS15 step-scaled has no prior map baseline.

Expansion requires all6 candidate fits completed/admitted at unchanged geometry thresholds, mean Dice gain>0 and mean HD95 change<0 vsstep-scaled baseline, no pair Dice loss>.005 or HD95 increase>.1mm. Failure stops expansion; no case replacement/extra iterations/label-selected checkpoint. Budget and controller stops remain nonconverged. Implementation preparation is underway, but acquired grid/boundary checks, remaining D01 scoring and P02 comparison gate execution. Explicit regularized energy and meaningful stopping remain separate O01/O02 experiments; no principal anatomical cause or qualification claimed.
